Chat engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume messaging capability in the binary covers storefront language. Xcode, chat frameworks, and Connect actually separate in-app messaging behavior from product-page copy:

  • MessageUI & MFMessageComposeViewController — system compose sheets your app may invoke to send SMS or iMessage. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains chat value to buyers browsing the App Store. AppLocale does not implement this.
  • Messages.framework & IMService — iMessage app extension targets, message routing, and service identifiers. Controls whether your iMessage app appears in the Messages drawer. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • RCS & carrier messaging backends — rich communication services, SMS gateways, and message delivery pipelines. Your listing may mention RCS or text messaging; implementing protocol stacks is engineering, not Connect metadata.
  • In-app chat UI & group thread logic — conversation lists, tapback pickers, read receipts, and compose field labels on your screens. Your listing may mention group chats; implementing thread sync is engineering, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of chat features in the binary.

Working chat UX in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Messages-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Messaging listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe chat and texting — not a literal paste of US marketing:

信息 vs 短信 vs 消息 vs 信息应用

US pages use "Messages", "Text messages", "Group Chat", "iMessage", or "Chat app." Chinese buyers expect concise 信息, 短信, 消息, or 信息应用 phrasing rather than English slogans left on screenshot overlays — without implying you are Apple Messages or operate chat servers for every platform shown in art. 短信 fits carrier SMS positioning; 消息 fits general conversation threads; 信息应用 fits standalone messaging utilities.

Group chat vs tapbacks vs iMessage apps

Screenshot overlays and description leads reference whether users see multi-person threads, reaction bubbles, or iMessage app drawers. Chinese buyers expect concrete labels (群聊, 消息回应, iMessage 应用) rather than vague English slogans ("Stay connected", "React with tapbacks") that hide what the chat flow actually does.

RCS & rich texting

Some listings reference RCS, read receipts, typing indicators, or rich media in text threads. These are factual product claims in description or screenshot copy — not substitutes for implementing carrier RCS backends or message sync in your app, which AppLocale does not engineer.

iMessage as a search term

China buyers who know Apple messaging may search iMessage alongside 信息 or 短信. AppLocale weaves iMessage into keywords and subtitle when your English listing legitimately markets iMessage app or blue-bubble compatibility — without over-claiming features your binary does not ship.

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need messaging-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 群聊, 短信, and 信息应用 each signal different intent from generic social keywords.

Common mistakes on Messages zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming chat features localize automatically — iMessage extension or group chat logic wired in Xcode; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and chat-themed screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating chat marketing with Mail or NameDrop — inbox folders and contact-exchange posters use different buyer vocabulary; see Mail listing guide and NameDrop listing guide, not this page
  • Calling the app "Apple Messages replacement" — 替代信息 overclaims when the app only adds stickers, filters, or companion UX on top of system messaging
  • Implying universal RCS or carrier coverage — listing claims RCS everywhere when delivery depends on carrier support and your backend regions
  • Conflating listing copy with in-app compose labels — message field placeholders and thread-row text are binary localization, not Connect metadata
  • English "Group Chat" on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in chat mockups on PNG exports are still Latin

Messages screenshot captions Chinese buyers expect

Social, productivity, and utility apps often dedicate one or two gallery frames to the messaging story — conversation threads, group chat lists, tapback bubbles, or iMessage app drawer art. Overlay lines on those frames should name the feature in plain zh-Hans:

  • Group chat frame — describe the multi-person benefit: "创建群聊，多人畅聊不掉线" instead of "Group Chat" alone
  • Tapback frame — name the reaction benefit honestly: "消息回应，一键点赞或回复" vs vague "React to messages" when tapbacks are the actual deliverable
  • iMessage app frame — explain the drawer value: "在 iMessage 中直接使用，无需切换应用" — not English-only "iMessage app"
  • RCS or rich text frame — state the texting benefit only when shipped: "富媒体短信，图片视频轻松发送" when art shows RCS or MMS-style threads
  • Match caption to capture — if the screenshot shows a business team chat, the overlay should describe 团队群聊 not consumer Apple Messages UI unless art shows that context

Why do my Messages screenshot captions still show English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you filled en-US screenshot text but never saved zh-Hans caption lines — or uploaded the same English-overlay PNGs to the Chinese set — China buyers see Latin chat badges on the product page.

Should zh-Hans copy use 信息, 短信, or 消息?

Chinese App Store readers and search intent differ by messaging feature. 信息 and 信息应用 are broad terms for messaging utilities. 短信 fits SMS and carrier-text positioning. 消息 fits general chat threads. iMessage may appear when your listing legitimately markets Apple messaging. AppLocale picks phrasing that fits your English claims — we do not invent chat capabilities your binary does not support.
